proof.text: For each open U, apply the official determinant_wedgeMorphism_local_data_at to the same short exact complex, ranks and rank equation. This gives a morphism between the native exterior powers with the desired formula on lifted wedge sections.

Precompose this morphism with the tensor of the hom maps of exteriorSheafPowerIso for S.X₁ and S.X₃, and postcompose with its inverse for S.X₂. The inverse wedge formula and the isomorphism identities give the forward wedge formula. tensorHom_app_tmulSection sends each legacy wedge tensor to the native wedge tensor; apply the official formula and then the inverse comparison wedge formula. The resulting morphism has exactly the original legacy section formula for every a, b, c and lift equation.

title: Local wedge morphisms on opens
statement: For a scheme X, a short exact complex S of sheaves of modules, natural numbers r₁,r₂,r₃ with r₂ = r₁ + r₃, and A finite locally free of rank r₁, every open U admits a sheaf morphism φU from the tensor of exterior sheaves to the exterior sheaf of S.X₂ whose value on pure wedge sections is the prescribed concatenated wedge for any quotient lift over U.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_local_data {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] :
    ∀ (U : X.Opens), ∃ φU : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂,
      ∀ (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        φU.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) =
          exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
